absent: Locking, concurrency, interrupt context and memory-ordering rules for GHCB, SVSM areas, RMP helpers and message descriptors are not shown.
Full GHCB and SVSM call sequences, hypervisor interaction flows and retry or error-recovery state machines beyond result enums are not shown.
Implementations and side effects of non-stub helpers, input validation, page-table updates and RMP entry changes are not shown.
SGX ENCLS execution semantics, EINIT authorization, launch control and fault handling beyond constants and layouts are not shown.
TDX hypercall and module-call arguments, return codes and virtualization-exception handling beyond numeric identifiers are not shown.
Port I/O and MSR access ordering, barriers and permitted contexts beyond inline emission are not shown.

findings.text: Error reporting uses small integers where identifier GHCB_ERR_NOT_REGISTERED corresponds to one and GHCB_ERR_INVALID_USAGE corresponds to two, while GHCB_ERR_INVALID_SCRATCH_AREA corresponds to three and GHCB_ERR_MISSING_INPUT corresponds to four, with GHCB_ERR_INVALID_INPUT corresponding to five and GHCB_ERR_INVALID_EVENT corresponding to six.

Configuration state packs three single-bit requests named debug plus ghcbs_initialized plus use_cas together with a sixty-one-bit reservation named __reserved, where the second flag records that per-CPU communication areas are usable on boot and application processors and the third flag selects per-CPU secure-module areas over boot areas.
Protocol evolution is bounded by GHCB_PROTOCOL_MIN equal to one and GHCB_PROTOCOL_MAX equal to two, with GHCB_DEFAULT_USAGE equal to zero for default selection.

Emulation outcome distinguishes ES_OK meaning success from ES_UNSUPPORTED meaning operation not available, plus ES_VMM_ERROR meaning hypervisor gave unexpected state, plus ES_DECODE_FAILED meaning decode failed, plus ES_EXCEPTION meaning fault raised, plus ES_RETRY meaning caller should retry.
Fault detail groups vector with error_code and cr2, while emulation context named es_em_ctxt joins register pointer named regs with decoded instruction named insn and fault detail named fi.

Confidential blob descriptor named cc_blob_sev_info sequences magic then version then reserved, followed by secrets_phys with secrets_len and rsvd1, then cpuid_phys with cpuid_len and rsvd2, using packed representation without padding.
Header marker CC_BLOB_SEV_HDR_MAGIC equals hexadecimal 45444D41, and CPUID capacity SNP_CPUID_COUNT_MAX equals sixty-four entries.

CPUID entry named snp_cpuid_fn pairs input selectors eax_in and ecx_in plus xcr0_in and xss_in with outputs eax plus ebx plus ecx plus edx and reservation __reserved, while table named snp_cpuid_table holds count plus __reserved1 plus __reserved2 plus array fn sized by capacity, both packed.

Failure encodings assign PVALIDATE_FAIL_SIZEMISMATCH to six and PVALIDATE_FAIL_NOUPDATE to two hundred fifty-five, with RMPUPDATE_FAIL_OVERLAP assigned to four and PSMASH_FAIL_INUSE assigned to three.

Size encoding assigns RMP_PG_SIZE_4K to zero for small pages and RMP_PG_SIZE_2M to one for large pages, with conversion helpers RMP_TO_PG_LEVEL and PG_LEVEL_TO_RMP mapping between encodings and page levels, and RMPADJUST_VMSA_PAGE_BIT marks bit sixteen for VMSA adjustment.
Reverse-map entry named rmp_state combines address gpa with flags assigned plus pagesize plus immutable plus rsvd and identifier asid, packed.
Request routing named snp_req_data carries request address req_gpa with response address resp_gpa and data address data_gpa plus page count data_npages.

Message protection sizes set MAX_AUTHTAG_LEN to thirty-two and AUTHTAG_LEN to sixteen with AAD_LEN to forty-eight and MSG_HDR_VER to one, while retry policy sets SNP_REQ_MAX_RETRY_DURATION to sixty times HZ and SNP_REQ_RETRY_DELAY to two times HZ.

Guest message kinds pair CPUID plus key plus report plus export plus import plus absorb plus VMARK each with request followed by response, starting from SNP_MSG_TYPE_INVALID as zero and bounded by SNP_MSG_TYPE_MAX, with SNP_MSG_TSC_INFO_REQ at seventeen and SNP_MSG_TSC_INFO_RSP next; cipher suite offers SNP_AEAD_INVALID and SNP_AEAD_AES_256_GCM.

Guest envelope header named snp_guest_msg_hdr provides tag storage authtag with sequence msg_seqno plus reserved rsvd1, algorithm algo with hdr_version and hdr_sz, type triple msg_type with msg_version and msg_sz plus rsvd2, and selector msg_vmpck with rsvd3; envelope named snp_guest_msg joins header hdr with payload filling remainder of page; TSC request named snp_tsc_info_req is reserved of size SNP_TSC_INFO_REQ_SZ equal to one twenty-eight, while response named snp_tsc_info_resp returns status plus tsc_scale plus tsc_offset plus tsc_factor with reservations.

Guest transaction descriptor named snp_guest_req holds request buffer req_buf with length req_sz and response buffer resp_buf with length resp_sz, plus exit_code with exitinfo2, selector vmpck_id, version msg_version with type msg_type, routing input, and certificate data certs_data.
Operating-system area named secrets_os_area keeps four sequence counters msg_seqno_0 through msg_seqno_3 with jump-table address ap_jump_table_pa plus reserved rsvd and usage guest_usage, packed.
VMPCK key length VMPCK_KEY_LEN equals thirty-two.

Secrets page named snp_secrets_page records version with imien flag, feature fms, guest view gosvw, four keys vmpck0 through vmpck3, embedded os_area, tweak bitmap vmsa_tweak_bitmap, secure-module range svsm_base with svsm_size and svsm_caa plus svsm_max_version and svsm_guest_vmpl, frequency factor tsc_factor, and large reservation; message descriptor named snp_msg_desc links shared request with response, double-buffered secret_request with secret_response, plus secrets, gcm_key, os_area_msg_seqno, vmpck and vmpck_id.
Secure-module call area named svsm_ca starts with flags call_pending and mem_available plus reservation rsvd1, followed by buffer svsm_buffer occupying page remainder after eight header bytes.

Secure-module results define SVSM_SUCCESS as zero and SVSM_ERR_INCOMPLETE as hex 80000000, with unsupported protocol at 80000001 and unsupported call at 80000002, invalid address at 80000003 and invalid format at 80000004, invalid parameter at 80000005 and invalid request at 80000006, busy at 80000007, and size-mismatch validation failure at 80001006.

Validation entry named svsm_pvalidate_entry packs page_size with action plus ignore_cf plus rsvd and frame pfn, while batch named svsm_pvalidate_call carries count num_entries with progress cur_index plus reservation and flexible array entry; capacity SVSM_PVALIDATE_MAX_COUNT derives from buffer size minus header divided by entry size.

Location entry named svsm_loc_entry pairs address pa with length len plus reservation, and attestation batch named svsm_attest_call groups report_buf with nonce plus manifest_buf plus certificates_buf, plus service_guid with service_manifest_ver and reservation.

Page-table update descriptor named pte_enc_desc references table entry kpte with level pte_level and direction encrypt, plus frame pfn with physical pa and virtual va and covered size, and replacement protection new_pgprot.

Secure-module invocation named svsm_call anchors call area caa and carries input registers rax with rcx plus rdx plus r8 plus r9 alongside outputs rax_out with rcx_out plus rdx_out plus r8_out plus r9_out.

Core service numbers assign SVSM_CORE_REMAP_CA to zero with PVALIDATE to one and CREATE_VCPU to two and DELETE_VCPU to three, while attestation constructor SVSM_ATTEST_CALL shifts one by thirty-two and ors index, with SERVICES at zero and SINGLE_SERVICE at one; virtual TPM numbers assign SVSM_VTPM_QUERY to zero and SVSM_VTPM_CMD to one.

Interrupt-stack and nonmaskable-interrupt helpers named sev_es_ist_enter with sev_es_ist_exit and sev_es_nmi_complete first check vendor equals AMD and platform reports guest state encryption, delegating to internal variants only when both hold and otherwise doing nothing.

CPUID leaf record named cpuid_leaf stores selector fn with subfn and outputs eax plus ebx plus ecx plus edx; state-change descriptor named psc_desc combines operation op with call area ca and physical address caa_pa.

When secure extensions are unavailable, virtual privilege level snp_vmpl is zero, setup_ghcb plus IST entry plus IST exit plus NMI completion plus enable do nothing, AP jump-table setup and EFI mapping report success zero.

Unavailable SNP makes shared-private memory transitions plus secondary wakeup plus DMI setup plus accept-memory plus kexec begin-finish plus secure-TSC prepare-init do nothing, makes init report false and unsupported-feature and status queries report zero with status display silent, makes attestation report negated ENOTTY and message init report minus one with allocation returning null and send plus TPM command reporting negated ENODEV.

Unavailable SAVIC makes GPA registration report unsupported and unregistration likewise, with MSR write doing nothing and MSR read returning zero; unavailable RMP makes probing report false and table init report negated ENOSYS with lookup plus smash plus make-private plus make-shared reporting negated ENODEV and dumps plus leak helpers doing nothing, while kdump plus E820 fixup plus shutdown do nothing and prepare reports negated ENODEV.

Enclave identification uses SGX_CPUID leaf eighteen, with EPC enumeration subleaf SGX_CPUID_EPC equal to two, where type SGX_CPUID_EPC_INVALID equals zero for terminator and SGX_CPUID_EPC_SECTION equals one for section, masked by SGX_CPUID_EPC_MASK covering low four bits.

Enclave control leaves assign ECREATE zero with EADD one and EINIT two plus EREMOVE three, debug read four with debug write five and extend six, then ELDU eight with EBLOCK nine and EPA ten plus EWB eleven, tracking twelve with augmentation thirteen and permission change fourteen plus type change fifteen, and SVN update twenty-four.

Enclave failures encode EPC conflict seven with not-tracked eleven and child-present thirteen plus invalid token sixteen, plus not-modifiable twenty with insufficient entropy twenty-nine and no-update thirty-one plus unmasked event one twenty-eight; fault flag SGX_ENCLS_FAULT_FLAG equals hex 40000000.

Miscellaneous selection defines SGX_MISC_EXINFO as bit zero with reserved mask covering bits sixty-three through one, plus save areas SGX_SSA_GPRS_SIZE one eighty-four and SGX_SSA_MISC_EXINFO_SIZE sixteen; attributes place INIT zero with DEBUG one and MODE64BIT two plus PROVISIONKEY four with EINITTOKENKEY five and KSS seven plus ASYNC_EXIT_NOTIFY ten, with reserved mask spanning three plus six plus eight plus nine plus eleven through sixty-three, unprivileged mask grouping debug with mode plus KSS plus notify, privileged mask grouping provision with token; modulus SGX_MODULUS_SIZE equals three eighty-four.

Enclave descriptor named sgx_secs orders size with base plus ssa_frame_size and miscselect, reserved area, attributes with xfrm, hashes mrenclave and mrsigner with config_id, identifiers isv_prod_id with isv_svn and config_svn, plus large tail reservation, packed; thread descriptor named sgx_tcs orders state with flags plus ssa_offset, index ssa_index with nr_ssa_frames, entry_offset with exit_addr, segment bases fs_offset with gs_offset and limits fs_limit with gs_limit, plus reservation sized SGX_TCS_RESERVED_SIZE equal to four thousand twenty-four, packed; flag SGX_TCS_DBGOPTIN equals one with reserved mask covering bits sixty-three through one.

Paging helpers define pageinfo named sgx_pageinfo with addr plus contents plus metadata plus secs, packed and thirty-two-byte aligned; page types order SECS zero with TCS one and REG two plus VA three and TRIM four, count SGX_NR_PAGE_TYPES five masked by SGX_PAGE_TYPE_MASK low eight bits; permission flags define R bit zero with W bit one and X bit two plus type encodings shifted by eight, with permission mask low three bits and type mask shifted plus reserved complement; info named sgx_secinfo pairs flags with fifty-six reserved bytes, packed and sixty-four-byte aligned; paging command named sgx_pcmd joins secinfo with enclave_id plus forty reserved bytes and sixteen-byte mac, packed and one twenty-eight-byte aligned.

Signature header named sgx_sigstruct_header sequences header1 pair with vendor plus date and header2 pair plus swdefined and eighty-four reserved bytes; body named sgx_sigstruct_body sequences miscselect with misc_mask plus twenty reserved bytes, attributes with xfrm and masks attributes_mask with xfrm_mask, hash mrenclave thirty-two bytes with thirty-two reserved bytes, plus isvprodid with isvsvn; full signature named sgx_sigstruct joins header with modulus plus exponent plus signature plus body plus twelve reserved bytes plus q1 with q2, packed; launch token size SGX_LAUNCH_TOKEN_SIZE equals three hundred four.

Port access generator named BUILDIO produces byte plus word plus long output and input helpers using port instructions, with public aliases inb with inw plus inl and outb with outw plus outl mapped to internal double-underscore variants.
Model-specific register view named msr unions low-high pair l with h against quad q for sixty-four-bit access.

Register writer named raw_wrmsr takes register number plus pointer to register view and issues privileged write wiring number to selector with low half to low accumulator and high half to high accumulator, treating memory as clobbered.

Trust-domain interface fixes TDX_HYPERCALL_STANDARD at zero with CPUID leaf TDX_CPUID_LEAF_ID at thirty-three and identity TDX_IDENT as IntelTDX padded; module calls assign TDG_VP_VMCALL zero with VP_INFO one and RTMR_EXTEND two plus VEINFO_GET three and REPORT four, plus PAGE_ACCEPT six with VM_RD seven and VM_WR eight.
Each header defines a once-only inclusion guard that expands to itself to prevent double inclusion.

Shared guest messages must be staged through encrypted-memory copies secret_request with secret_response rather than using shared request with response directly, to avoid leaking stale data; boot code must not use per-CPU communication areas before ghcbs_initialized is set nor per-CPU call areas before use_cas is set, since application processors create theirs during bringup.
